fields.label: Insurance
fields.hint: fraction (0.25 = 25%), % of FA/yr · Typically ~0.4% of gross fixed assets p.a. (fire, burglary, breakdown).

fields.label: Other admin overheads
fields.hint: Rs LAKH (40 lakh = 40, NOT 4000000), per month · Office, travel, communication, audit, statutory, misc.

fields.label: Selling & distribution
fields.hint: fraction (0.25 = 25%), % of sales · Freight, commission, marketing & distribution (variable with sales).

fields.hint: Rs LAKH (40 lakh = 40, NOT 4000000) · Funds ~57% of fixed assets. See 'Project Cost' sheet.

fields.label: Promoter equity / capital
fields.hint: Rs LAKH (40 lakh = 40, NOT 4000000) · Balancing contribution incl. WC margin money; D:E ≈ 1.04.

fields.label: Term-loan interest rate
fields.hint: fraction (0.25 = 25%), % p.a. · MSME term loan ≈ Repo (5.25%) + ~2.65% + spread. SBI/BoB EBLR basis, 2026.

fields.label: Term-loan moratorium (principal)
fields.hint: months (whole number) · Principal holiday during ramp-up; interest serviced monthly.

fields.label: Term-loan repayment period
fields.hint: months (whole number) · Equal monthly principal after moratorium (8-yr door-to-door).

fields.label: Working-capital (CC) interest rate
fields.hint: fraction (0.25 = 25%), % p.a. · Cash-credit on assessed bank finance. MSME WC 2026.

fields.label: Raw-material / stock inventory  (days of consumption held)
fields.hint: days · Days of direct-cost consumption held in stock.

fields.hint: days · Days of cost of operations held as finished stock.

fields.label: Receivables (debtors)
fields.hint: days · Credit allowed to customers.

fields.label: Payables (creditors)
fields.hint: days · Credit received from suppliers.

fields.label: Margin on working capital (NWC)
fields.hint: fraction (0.25 = 25%) · Tandon 2nd method: 25% of current assets from long-term funds.

fields.hint: fraction (0.25 = 25%), % SLM · Building / civil — Companies Act Sch II (typical life ~30 yrs; confirm per asset).

fields.label: Equipment, machinery & systems depreciation (SLM)
fields.hint: fraction (0.25 = 25%), % SLM · Equipment / machinery — Companies Act Sch II (typical life ~15 yrs; set per asset type).

fields.hint: fraction (0.25 = 25%), % SLM · Electrical installation — Companies Act Sch II (~10 yrs).

fields.label: Utilities depreciation (SLM)
fields.hint: fraction (0.25 = 25%), % SLM · Utilities & services — Companies Act Sch II (~15 yrs).

fields.label: Misc / office assets depreciation (SLM)
fields.hint: fraction (0.25 = 25%), % SLM · Office / furniture / IT — Companies Act Sch II (furniture 10 yrs, computers 3 yrs).

fields.label: Pre-operative amortisation
fields.hint: fraction (0.25 = 25%), % / yr · Written off over 5 years (straight line).

fields.label: Corporate tax rate (effective)
fields.hint: fraction (0.25 = 25%) · Sec 115BAA new domestic company: 22% + surcharge + cess ≈ 25.17%.

fields.label: GST (pass-through)
fields.hint: fraction (0.25 = 25%) · Illustrative 18% output & input GST; revenue modelled net of GST. Set to the product’s actual GST rate.

fields.hint: Rs LAKH (40 lakh = 40, NOT 4000000) · Panels, wiring, transformer, DG / UPS back-up.

fields.label: Utilities & services (water, HVAC, fire-fighting etc.)
fields.hint: Rs LAKH (40 lakh = 40, NOT 4000000) · Water, cooling / air-conditioning, fire-fighting, other services.

fields.label: Miscellaneous fixed assets (office, IT, furniture, tools)
fields.hint: Rs LAKH (40 lakh = 40, NOT 4000000) · Furniture, computers, software / ERP, tools, testing equipment.

fields.label: Contingency
fields.hint: Rs LAKH (40 lakh = 40, NOT 4000000) · ~3% on equipment / civil for cost overrun.

fields.label: Pre-operative & preliminary expenses
fields.hint: Rs LAKH (40 lakh = 40, NOT 4000000) · Trial runs, interest during construction, fees, start-up and licensing costs.

fields.label: Margin money for working capital
fields.hint: Rs LAKH (40 lakh = 40, NOT 4000000) · Promoter margin toward the first working-capital cycle.

constraints: Money cells are in Rs LAKH (40 lakh = 40, never 4000000); only the per-unit price/cost cells are plain Rs per unit. Every percent is a decimal fraction (0.25 = 25%). Term loan (Assumptions!B51) + promoter equity (Assumptions!B52) MUST equal the sum of the Project Cost cells C5..C13. The model must be viable: positive EBITDA from Year 1 and average DSCR >= 1.5.
